Rounded to the nearest tenth, what is the area of the quadrilateral $ABCD$?

> A scientific calculator is required to answer this question.
corrected_content.worked_solution: Split the convex quadrilateral along $BD$ into triangles with included angles $80^\circ$ and $50^\circ$. Add their areas: $$[ABCD]=\tfrac12(5)(8)\sin80^\circ+\tfrac12(10)(7)\sin50^\circ\approx46.50771.$$ Rounded to the nearest tenth, the area is $46.5$.
